title: Share it with the student
subtitle: Chapter 6 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: A lesson entry stays in your private coaching record until you share it.
For a connected student, Share with sends it directly to their Journal.
If you edit the entry later, the version in their Journal updates too.
You can stop sharing at any time.
For someone without an account, copy a public link to that individual entry.
The link does not expose the rest of the student's record.
